title: Chapter 403 Territory Migration Scroll
content:
Chapter 403 Territory Migration Scroll

Iron-blooded city.

Liu Hong was furious at this time.

The commander Jin Guozhu he sent to attack Dahuai Territory fell.

This incident hit him quite hard.

First, Ni Wu was killed by Wang Shuo, and then Jin Guozhu was destroyed by the Black Dragon King, and an elite team was also destroyed.

Liu Hong's eyes flashed fiercely and he was furious.

If it weren't for the strength limitations of the vanguard army that entered the Dahuai Territory this time, there would be no such trouble.

Simply send a team of 10 intermediate generals to carry out the beheading operation.

But Dahuai Territory has not yet been officially connected to the outside world, and everything must be done according to the rules.

After calming down, Liu Hong narrowed his eyes and had a new plan in his mind.

Dahuaiyu must be captured.

Qingyang Mansion.

Qingyang Lord Dongfang Ke and Sunset Lord Wang Zhu were sitting at a small table.

"Brother Dongfang, the Iron-Blooded City is ready to move again at this time. I think the emergence of the Great Sophora Region is an opportunity for us."

"Um, Brother Wang, what do you have to say?"

At this time, the army of Iron Blood City was on the border with Chen Bing, and his daughter was lost in Dahuai Territory, and the guard was killed, so he was a little confused.

"Look!" Wang Zhu immediately asked his men to deliver a partial map.

He pointed at a triangular area with his hand.

Said with a smile.

"Brother Dongfang, look at this place."

The location he was pointing to was exactly north of the Great Steel Wall.

"This place is exactly where the Iron Blood Ridge and the Wagarian Empire meet. It forms a triangle with the Great Sophora Valley."

If we also reach an agreement with the Demon Tribe Royal Court of Dahuai Territory and Wagliang Empire, then Liu Hong will not feel comfortable. He is equivalent to being surrounded by our forces from all directions. "

Dongfang Ke shook his head and said: "Demon King Maris has always been on good terms with Liu Hong, how can he form an alliance with us?"

"Brother Dongfang, there are no eternal enemies, only eternal interests. How can you know if you don't give it a try?"

Wang Zhu could only do his best at this time.

He originally occupied 4 large cities with a population of millions, but now only one city is left, barely surviving.

Originally, the priest told him that Dahuaiyu was his hope, but it was obvious that conquering Dahuaiyu was no longer possible.

Wang Shuo, who invested, also rejected him. The best situation now is to form an alliance with Dahuaiyu to fight against the Iron-Blooded City together.

After the two discussed, they decided that Dongfang Ke would contact Dahuaiyu to form an alliance.

Wang Zhu is responsible for contacting the demon clan of the Wagarian Empire.

…

Shanhai City Lord's Mansion.

Wang Shuo suddenly said: "You two, I have a bad guess."

As he said this, Wang Shuo's expression darkened.

"Perhaps when the Great Sophora Domain is completely connected to the outside world, I'm afraid the system functions will completely disappear."

Zhao Bond and Zhu Dongheng looked at each other.

"Yes, as far as I know, that is indeed the case."

"I have also taken over tasks in foreign lands. Only a few special places still retain system functions. Therefore, these few months are our last bonus period. We must seize the time to develop."

Zhao Bond touched his beard and said slowly.

Zhu Dongheng looked at Wang Shuo and said thoughtfully: "Wang Commandery, I wonder if you need our help in rebuilding Fenglin County?"

Wang Shuo still found it a bit difficult to control a county.

He has no further ideas for the time being. After all, the various properties of Wana County make him reluctant to part with it.

Seeing Wang Shuo's embarrassed look.

Zhu Dongheng took the initiative and took out a scroll.

"This is a territory transfer scroll that can completely transfer your entire Wana County to the old site of Fenglin County."
